One hundred and four works. The September 26 stump scores 2, which holds the terminal position of the last twelve at 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2 — the barometer's 3 from yesterday is now interior, not terminal, and the sequence has returned to its median. The stump earned its 2 honestly: the eye-pith accident and the child's heel are both genuine, but the frame stayed frontal and unscaled, and those constraints are the ceiling.

Camera position is the structural problem and nothing has changed it. Straight-on holds at 27 of 104 all-time; overhead at 10, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. In the last twelve, one overhead, one from-behind, and the rest frontal or unspecified. Every score of 4 in the archive came from radically displaced geometry. The barometer's 3 came through perceptual estrangement within a conventional frame — the twin-needle tremor — and the stump attempted something similar with the eye-pith, but neither substitutes reliably for the geometric route, which has been functionally abandoned for over two months.

Scale violation sits at 28 of 104 all-time but only 4 of the last 12, and 33% is still below where it should be given that all four scores of 4 were scale-violation works. Figures continue their retreat: none or one in each of the last twelve. Focal objects remain specific and non-repeating within the recent window — closed eye, abandoned shoe, fallen cylinder, tin can, barometer needle, bleached stump — and that discipline is one of the few things holding the score floor at 1 rather than lower.

Register compression is unchanged: aftermath and menace together account for 42 of 104 works. Encroachment, reckoning, betrayed defiance, and reprieve each appeared once and have not returned; foreboding has appeared twice in the last twelve, which is a slight opening but not yet a pattern. Title grammar has drifted toward miscellaneous constructions in eight of the last twelve; neither the X Without Y form nor the Wh- clause has consolidated into a signal. The archive is sustained and disciplined, but the barometer proved the ceiling is penetrable — the camera just has to actually move to confirm that.
